description: Speak to the official monday.com Platform MCP server (https://mcp.monday.com/mcp) — 59 tools for boards, items, docs, dashboards, forms, workflows, automations, AI agents, sprints and assets over Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC.

api.description: Browses the account-wide catalog of available trigger types and skills for monday platform agents using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: list_triggers or list_skills.
Used with list_triggers. Fetch specific trigger types by block_reference_id. Omit to return all trigger types.

api.description: Full lifecycle management for monday platform agents — create, read, update, delete, change state, and run — using the Platform MCP.

fields.type: create | create_blank | get | update | delete | activate | deactivate | run
fields.description: One of create, create_blank, get, update, delete, activate, deactivate, run.
Required for update, delete, activate, deactivate, run. Use with get to fetch a specific agent; omit it with get to list owned agents.
Required for create. Plain-language description of what the agent should do.
Used with create or update. Omit unless the user explicitly names a valid monday-supported model.
Used with create_blank or update. Display name of the agent.
Used with create_blank or update. Short role title (e.g. "Customer Success Bot").
Used with create_blank or update. Detailed description of the agent role.
Used with create_blank. HTTPS URL of the avatar. Prefer dapulse-res.cloudinary.com or cdn.monday.com.
Used with create_blank. male or female — a hint for the generated avatar/name when profile fields are omitted.
Used with create_blank. Lowercase hex, e.g. "#9450fd".
Used with create_blank. Stored as metadata; not used for AI generation.
Used with update. New step-by-step execution plan in markdown.

api.description: Lists, grants, updates, or revokes a monday platform agent's access to boards and docs using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: One of list, add, update, remove.
Unique identifier of the agent.
Required for add, update, remove. The ID of the board or doc to grant/update/revoke access to.
Required for add, update, remove. The resource type: BOARD or DOC.
Required for add and update. READ (agent can read) or READ_WRITE (agent can read and write).

api.description: Creates skills in the account catalog and attaches or detaches them from a monday platform agent using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: One of create, add, remove.
Required for add and remove. Not used for create (an account-level operation).
Required for create. Display name of the new skill.
Required for create. Markdown instructions defining what the skill does and how to execute it — this is the skill's runtime behavior.
Used with create. Short description shown in the catalog.
Required for add and remove. The skill ID from agent_catalog action: "list_skills", or the ID returned by action: "create". Never guess a skill ID.

api.description: Lists, adds, or removes the triggers attached to a monday platform agent — triggers define when the agent runs automatically — using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: One of list, add, remove.
Unique identifier of the agent.
Required for add. The trigger type's block_reference_id from agent_catalog action: "list_triggers". Never guess this value.

Used with add when the trigger type has required fields. Key/value object whose shape is described by field_schemas in the catalog. Scalar fields use string/number/boolean; selection fields use {'{ "value": "", "label": "" }'}.
Required for remove. The node_id of the trigger instance — get it from action: "list". Each instance has a unique node_id.

api.description: Completes a file upload started with get_asset_upload_url, creates the asset, and attaches it to an item's file column using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The upload_id returned by get_asset_upload_url.
The ETag header value from the PUT response when uploading to the presigned URL.
The board's unique identifier. Optional; the server resolves the board from the item.
The item's unique identifier.
The file or doc column's unique identifier to attach the uploaded asset to.

api.description: Retrieves file metadata for one or more monday.com assets by their IDs, including download URL, thumbnail, size, and uploader information using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: Array of asset IDs to fetch. Must contain at least one ID. Asset IDs are numeric strings (e.g., `["12345678"]`).

api.description: Returns a presigned URL to upload a file to monday.com, the first step in attaching a file to an item using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The name of the file to upload, including extension (e.g. "report.pdf").
The MIME type of the file (e.g. "application/pdf", "image/png", "text/plain"). Optional when the extension is a known type.
The file size in bytes. Maximum 500 MB (524288000 bytes).

api.description: Creates an automation on a monday.com board from a structured natural-language description using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: Structured description of the automation to create, in the format the description of monday's `create_automation` MCP tool gives.
The numeric board ID as a string.

api.description: Lists all automations on a specific monday.com board, including their IDs, titles, active state, and configuration, using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The numeric board ID as a string.
Maximum number of automations to return (1–100). Default: 100.
Pagination cursor from a previous response. Pass it to retrieve the next page of automations.

api.description: Activates, deactivates, or deletes an existing monday.com automation using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The operation to perform: activate (enable a paused automation), deactivate (pause without deleting), or delete (permanently remove — irreversible).
The automation ID to operate on. Obtain it from list_automations.

api.description: Creates a new monday.com board in a specified workspace with configurable visibility, description, and ownership using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The display name of the new board.
Visibility level of the board. One of `public`, `private`, or `share`. Defaults to `public`.
A short description of the board's purpose.
The ID of the workspace to create the board in. Use `list_workspaces` to discover workspace IDs.
List of user IDs to set as board owners. Use `list_users_and_teams` to look up user IDs.

api.description: Returns the activity log for a board, showing what changed, when, and by whom, over a configurable time range using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the board to retrieve activity logs for.
Start of the activity window in ISO 8601 format (e.g. `2025-12-01T00:00:00Z`). Defaults to 30 days ago.
End of the activity window in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to the current time.
Whether to include the full before/after data payload for each event. Defaults to `false`. Can significantly increase response size.

api.description: Returns comprehensive metadata for a board, including its columns, groups, views, owners, and workspace details using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The numeric ID of the board to retrieve information for.

api.description: Retrieves items from a board with pagination, optional column values, filters, sorting, and sub-item support using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the board to retrieve items from.
Fetch specific items by their IDs (maximum 100).
Free-text search term. Use when the user provides an approximate term rather than an exact column value. Prefer structured `filters` for exact matches.
Number of items to return per page. Range: 1–500. Defaults to `25`.
Pagination cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor` field.
Whether to include column values. Defaults to `false`. Only enable when you need column data — it significantly increases response size.
Whether to include the item's rich-text description (body/notes). Defaults to `false`.
Whether to include sub-items for each item. Defaults to `false`.
Number of sub-items to return per item when `includeSubItems` is true. Range: 1–100. Defaults to `25`.

Array of column filter objects. Each filter requires `columnId` and `compareValue`, with optional `operator` and `compareAttribute`. Call `get_column_type_info` with `fetchMode: "guidelines"` to understand valid filter values per column type.
Logical operator for combining multiple filters. Either `and` (default) or `or`.
Limit which columns are returned when `includeColumns` is true. Omit to return all columns.
Array of sort objects with `columnId` and `direction` (`asc` or `desc`).

api.description: Calculates aggregated summaries of board data by filtering, grouping, and applying aggregation functions to columns using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the board to calculate insights for.

Array of aggregation objects, each with a `columnId` and an optional `function`. Supported functions include `COUNT`, `COUNT_ITEMS`, `SUM`, `AVERAGE`, `MIN`, `MAX`, `MEDIAN`, `LABEL`, `DATE_TRUNC_MONTH`, `DATE_TRUNC_WEEK`, and more. Columns in `groupBy` must also appear here without a function.
Array of column IDs to group results by. All groupBy columns must also be present in `aggregations` without a function.
Maximum number of result rows to return. Maximum 1000. Defaults to `1000`.
Array of column filter objects (same structure as `get_board_items_page` filters). Narrows the item set before aggregation.
Logical operator for combining multiple filters: `and` (default) or `or`.
Array of sort objects with `columnId` and `direction` (`asc` or `desc`).

api.description: Adds a new column of a specified type to a monday.com board, with an optional title, description, and type-specific settings using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the board to add the column to.

The type of column to create. Supported types include: `auto_number`, `board_relation`, `checkbox`, `date`, `dependency`, `dropdown`, `email`, `file`, `formula`, `hour`, `link`, `location`, `long_text`, `numbers`, `people`, `phone`, `rating`, `status`, `tags`, `team`, `text`, `time_tracking`, `timeline`, `vote`, `week`, `world_clock`, and others.
The display title for the new column.
An optional description shown in the column header tooltip.
Column-specific configuration as a JSON string. Use `get_column_type_info` with `fetchMode: "schema"` to get the correct structure for a given type.

api.description: Returns the JSON settings schema or filter/aggregation guidelines for a specific monday.com column type using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The column type to look up (e.g. `status`, `text`, `date`, `numbers`, `people`, `dropdown`, `timeline`).
Either `schema` (default) to get the full JSON settings schema, or `guidelines` to get only filter and aggregation rules.

api.description: Returns the complete JSON Schema definitions for all available widget types in monday.com, including required fields, data types, and configuration options using the Platform MCP.
Creates a new monday.com dashboard that aggregates and visualizes data from one or more boards using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: Human-readable title for the dashboard (UTF-8 characters).
ID of the workspace that will own the dashboard. Use `list_workspaces` or `workspace_info` to find workspace IDs.
List of board IDs (as strings) to connect to the dashboard. Minimum 1, maximum 50. All widgets on this dashboard will source data from these boards.
Visibility level: `PUBLIC` or `PRIVATE`. Defaults to `PUBLIC`.
Folder ID within the workspace to place the dashboard in. If omitted, the dashboard is placed in the workspace root.

api.description: Adds a new data visualization widget to a monday.com dashboard or board view with type-specific configuration settings using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: ID of the parent container — a dashboard ID or a board view ID.
Type of the parent container. Must be `DASHBOARD` or `BOARD_VIEW`.
The type of widget to create. One of: `APP_FEATURE`, `BATTERY`, `CALENDAR`, `CHART`, `GANTT`, `LISTVIEW`, `NUMBER`.
Display name for the widget (1–255 UTF-8 characters).
Widget-specific configuration as a JSON object. Must conform to the schema for the specified `widget_kind`. Use `all_widgets_schema` to retrieve the required structure for each type.

api.description: Creates a new monday.com document in a workspace or attached to a board item, then populates it with the provided markdown content using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The display name of the new document.
Markdown content to import into the document as blocks on creation.
Where to create the document. One of `workspace` (standalone doc) or `item` (attached to a board item).
The ID of the workspace to create the document in. Use `list_workspaces` to discover workspace IDs.
Visibility of the document. One of `public`, `private`, or `share`. Defaults to `public`. Only used when location=`workspace`.
ID of a folder to place the document inside. Only used when location=`workspace`. Use `search` with searchType `FOLDERS` to find folder IDs.
The ID of the board item to attach the document to. Only used when location=`item`.
ID of an existing doc column on the item's board. If omitted, a new doc column is created automatically. Only used when location=`item`.

api.description: Retrieves monday.com documents with their full markdown content and block structure, or fetches the version history of a single document using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: Operation mode. `content` (default) retrieves documents with markdown content. `version_history` retrieves the edit history of a single document.
Query type for content mode. One of `ids` (doc IDs), `object_ids` (object IDs from the URL), or `workspace_ids`. Required when mode is `content`.
Array of ID values matching the selected `type`. In `version_history` mode, provide the single document `object_id` here (e.g., `["18412502542"]`).
Number of documents per page (default: 25). Content mode only.
Page number to return, starting at 1. Content mode only.
Sort order for results. One of `created_at` or `used_at`. Content mode only.
If `true`, includes block IDs, types, positions, and content in the response. Required before calling `update_doc`. Defaults to `false`. Content mode only.
Maximum number of blocks to return per document (default: 25). Use with `blocks_page` to paginate long documents. Content mode only.
Page number for block pagination, starting at 1. Content mode only.
If `true`, fetches all comments and replies on the document. Defaults to `false`. Content mode only.
Maximum number of comments to fetch per document when `include_comments` is `true`. Defaults to 50. Content mode only.
Maximum number of restoring points to return. Version history mode only.
ISO 8601 date string to filter version history from (e.g., `"2026-03-15T00:00:00Z"`). Version history mode only.
ISO 8601 date string to filter version history until. Defaults to now. Version history mode only.
If `true`, fetches content diffs between consecutive restoring points. May be slower. Version history mode only.

api.description: Updates an existing monday.com document by executing an ordered list of operations such as appending content, renaming, editing blocks, or adding comments using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The document ID returned by `read_docs` (`id` field). Takes priority over `object_id` if both are provided.
The document object ID visible in the document URL. Resolved to `doc_id` internally.
Ordered list of operations to perform (1–25). Each operation requires an `operation_type` and type-specific fields; monday's `update_doc` MCP tool description lists the operation types.

api.description: Creates a new folder inside a monday.com workspace, with optional color, icon, font weight, and parent folder settings using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the workspace where the folder will be created.
The name of the folder.

The folder's color. One of: `AQUAMARINE`, `BRIGHT_BLUE`, `BRIGHT_GREEN`, `CHILI_BLUE`, `DARK_ORANGE`, `DARK_PURPLE`, `DARK_RED`, `DONE_GREEN`, `INDIGO`, `LIPSTICK`, `NULL`, `PURPLE`, `SOFIA_PINK`, `STUCK_RED`, `SUNSET`, `WORKING_ORANGE`.
The font weight of the folder label. One of: `FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD`, `FONT_WEIGHT_LIGHT`, `FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL`, `FONT_WEIGHT_VERY_LIGHT`, `NULL`.
The icon displayed on the folder. One of: `FOLDER`, `MOREBELOW`, `MOREBELOWFILLED`, `NULL`, `WORK`.
The ID of a parent folder to nest this folder inside. If omitted, the folder is created at the workspace root.

api.description: Moves a board, folder, or overview to a different position, parent folder, or workspace in monday.com using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The type of object to move. One of: `Board`, `Folder`, `Overview`.
The ID of the object to move.
The ID of the destination folder. Provide this to move the object into a specific folder.
The ID of the destination workspace. Provide this when moving the object to a different workspace.
The ID of the destination account product. Provide this when moving to a different account product context.
The ID of a reference object to position this object relative to. Must be paired with `position_object_type`.
The type of the reference object for positioning. One of: `Board`, `Folder`, `Overview`. Must be paired with `position_object_id`.
If `true`, places this object after the reference object. If `false`, places it before.

api.description: Updates the name, color, icon, position, or parent of an existing folder in monday.com using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the folder to update.
The new name for the folder.

The new color for the folder. One of: `AQUAMARINE`, `BRIGHT_BLUE`, `BRIGHT_GREEN`, `CHILI_BLUE`, `DARK_ORANGE`, `DARK_PURPLE`, `DARK_RED`, `DONE_GREEN`, `INDIGO`, `LIPSTICK`, `NULL`, `PURPLE`, `SOFIA_PINK`, `STUCK_RED`, `SUNSET`, `WORKING_ORANGE`.
The new font weight for the folder label. One of: `FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD`, `FONT_WEIGHT_LIGHT`, `FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL`, `FONT_WEIGHT_VERY_LIGHT`, `NULL`.
The new icon for the folder. One of: `FOLDER`, `MOREBELOW`, `MOREBELOWFILLED`, `NULL`, `WORK`.
The ID of the new parent folder to nest this folder inside.
The ID of the workspace containing the folder. Required when moving the folder to a different workspace.
The account product ID to associate with the folder.
The ID of an object to position this folder relative to. Must be paired with `position_object_type`.
The type of object used as the positioning reference. One of: `Board`, `Folder`, `Overview`. Must be paired with `position_object_id`.
If `true`, positions the folder after the reference object. If `false`, positions it before.

api.description: Creates a new monday.com WorkForm and a backing board to store responses, returning a form token for subsequent form operations using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: ID of the workspace in which the form and its backing board will be created.
Name of the backing board that stores form responses. If omitted, the board receives a default name.
Visibility of the backing board. One of `private`, `public`, or `share`.
ID of an existing folder to place the backing board in.
Name of a new folder to create and place the backing board in.
List of user IDs to set as owners of the backing board.
List of team IDs to set as owners of the backing board.
User IDs to notify on board activity.
Team IDs to notify on board activity.

api.description: Submits a completed response to a monday.com WorkForm, creating a new item on the form's backing board with the provided answers using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The form token, a full WorkForm URL, or a shortened wkf.ms URL. Shortened URLs are automatically resolved.

Array of answer objects. Each object must include question_id and exactly one answer field matching the question type; monday's `create_form_submission` MCP tool description lists the answer fields per type.
The submitter's timezone offset in minutes (e.g., -120 for UTC−2, 0 for UTC, 120 for UTC+2).
Required only if the form has password protection enabled (check features.password.enabled from get_form).
Routing tags to attach to the submission. Each tag maps a column_id to a value.

api.description: Creates, updates, or deletes a single question on a monday.com WorkForm, with support for 23 question types and conditional visibility rules using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The operation to perform: create, update, or delete.
The unique token identifying the form.
ID of the question to update or delete. Required for update and delete.
The question definition. Required for create. For update, required with type always included. monday's `form_questions_editor` MCP tool description lists its sub-fields.

api.description: Retrieves the full structure of a monday.com WorkForm by its form token, including all questions, settings, appearance, and features using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The unique token identifying the form. Extract from the form URL: the alphanumeric string after /forms/ and before ?.

api.description: Updates a monday.com WorkForm's settings, appearance, features, tags, or question order using a single action-based call using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The unique token identifying the form.
The operation to perform; monday's `update_form` MCP tool description lists the supported actions and their required fields.
Form data to update. Required for updateFormHeader, updateAppearance, updateAccessibility, updateFeatures, and updateQuestionOrder. Patch semantics — only include the fields you want to change.
Required for the setFormPassword action.
Required for createTag, updateTag, and deleteTag. For create: provide name and value. For update: provide id and new value. For delete: provide id only.

api.description: Creates a new group (section) in a monday.com board with an optional color and position relative to existing groups using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the board to create the group in.
The display name of the new group. Maximum 255 characters.

Hex color for the group header. Must be one of the 19 predefined monday.com group colors: `#037f4c`, `#00c875`, `#9cd326`, `#cab641`, `#ffcb00`, `#784bd1`, `#9d50dd`, `#007eb5`, `#579bfc`, `#66ccff`, `#bb3354`, `#df2f4a`, `#ff007f`, `#ff5ac4`, `#ff642e`, `#fdab3d`, `#7f5347`, `#c4c4c4`, `#757575`.
The ID of an existing group to position this group relative to. Use `get_board_info` to find group IDs.
Whether to place the new group `before_at` or `after_at` the `relativeTo` group.

api.description: Updates one or more column values on an existing monday.com item in a single call using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the board that contains the item.
The ID of the item to update.

A JSON string of column values to update. Keys are column IDs, values are type-specific. Examples: `{"text_col": "New value"}`, `{"status_col": {"label": "Done"}}`, `{"date_col": {"date": "2024-06-01"}}`, `{"email_col": "user@example.com"}`, `{"phone_col": "+1-800-555-0100"}`.
If `true`, creates new Status or Dropdown labels that don't already exist. Requires board structure modification permission. Defaults to `false`.

api.description: Creates a new item on a board, optionally with column values, as a sub-item under a parent, or as a duplicate of an existing item using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the board to create the item on.
The display name of the new item.

A JSON string of initial column values. Keys are column IDs, values are type-specific. Examples: `{"text_col": "hello"}`, `{"status_col": {"label": "Done"}}`, `{"date_col": {"date": "2024-05-10"}}`, `{"email_col": "user@example.com"}`.
The ID of the group to add the item to. Defaults to the board's top group if not specified.
The ID of a parent item to create this as a sub-item under.
The ID of an existing item to duplicate as the base. Only provide when duplicating an item.

api.description: Retrieves monday.com AI Notetaker meetings by ID, or lists recent ones, with optional summaries, topics, action items and transcripts using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: Meeting IDs to fetch in one call. Omit to list recent meetings for the chosen access level.
Which meetings to include. Defaults to ALL when ids are given; without ids, meetings shared only account-wide are left out unless ALL is passed.
Case-insensitive substring match on title, attendee name or email. Not a topic search.
Include the AI-generated summary for each meeting. The summary is returned when no include_ flag is set.
Include discussion topics for each meeting.
Include action items for each meeting.
Include the full transcript for each meeting. Transcripts can be very large.

api.description: Sends a notification to a user via the monday.com bell icon, with an optional email, targeting an update/reply or an item/board using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the user to send the notification to.
The ID of the target object. Provide an update or reply ID when `target_type` is `"Post"`, or an item or board ID when `target_type` is `"Project"`.
The notification message text.
The context for the notification link. `"Post"` links to an update or reply; `"Project"` links to an item or board.

api.description: Executes any monday.com GraphQL query or mutation dynamically. The most flexible tool in the Platform MCP, giving direct access to the full monday.com API surface.

fields.description: The full GraphQL query or mutation string to execute.
A JSON string containing the variables for the GraphQL operation. Defaults to "{}".

api.description: Fetches the monday.com GraphQL schema structure, including all available query fields, mutation fields, and a list of every type in the schema using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: Filter results by operation type. Use "read" to return only query fields, or "write" to return only mutation fields. Omit to return both.

api.description: Returns the full field list and type information for a specific GraphQL type in the monday.com API schema using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The exact name of the GraphQL type to inspect. Type names are case-sensitive (e.g., "Board", "Item", "Column").

api.description: Searches across monday.com for boards, documents, or folders by keyword, with optional filtering by workspace using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The type of objects to search. One of `BOARD`, `DOCUMENTS`, or `FOLDERS`.
The keyword to search for. Omit or pass an empty string to return all objects of the given type.
Number of results to return per page. Maximum and default is `20`.
Array of workspace IDs to scope the search. Only pass this when you want to restrict results to specific workspaces.

api.description: Discovers monday Dev sprint boards and their paired tasks boards in your account using the Platform MCP.
Returns a table of sprints from a monday Dev sprints board, including timeline, status, and completion data for each sprint using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the monday Dev board containing the sprints. Use `get_monday_dev_sprints_boards` to find this ID.
Number of sprints to retrieve. Between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.

api.description: Returns a complete AI-generated performance summary and analysis for a completed monday Dev sprint using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the sprint to get the summary for. Must be a completed sprint created after January 1, 2025. Use `get_sprints_metadata` to find sprint IDs.

api.description: Posts a new update (comment) on a monday.com item, with support for mentions and threaded replies using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the item to post the update on.
The update text. Use HTML tags for formatting. Do not use `@` mentions here — use `mentionsList` instead.
JSON array of mention objects. Each object requires an `id` and a `type`. Valid types: `User`, `Team`, `Board`, `Project`. Example: `[{"id": "48202303", "type": "User"}]`.
The ID of an existing update to reply to. Omit this parameter to create a top-level update.

api.description: Retrieves updates (comments and posts) from a monday.com item or board, with optional filtering by date range, replies, and file attachments using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the item or board to retrieve updates from.
The type of object: `"Item"` or `"Board"`.
Number of updates to return per page. Default: `25`. Maximum: `100`.
Page number for pagination. Default: `1`.
Set to `true` to include threaded replies on each update. Default: `false`.
Set to `true` to include file attachments in the response. Default: `false`.
Start of date range filter in ISO 8601 format (e.g. `"2025-01-01"` or `"2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"`). **Board queries only.** Must be used together with `toDate`.
End of date range filter in ISO 8601 format. **Board queries only.** Must be used together with `fromDate`.
When `objectType` is `"Board"`, set to `true` to include updates on individual items. Default: `false` (board-level discussion only).

api.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user, their account, and their most relevant boards, people, and workspaces using the Platform MCP.
Fetches user profiles and team data from the account, with several targeting modes for looking up specific users or teams efficiently using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: Returns the current user's profile including team memberships. **Top priority** — use whenever the request refers to "me" or "my teams". Conflicts with all other parameters.
Array of specific user IDs to fetch (max 500). Always use when user IDs are available in context. Returns user profiles including team memberships.
Fuzzy name search for **users only**. Standalone — cannot be combined with other parameters. Do not use to search for teams.
Array of specific team IDs to fetch (max 500). Always use when team IDs are known. Returns team details with owners and optional member data.
Fetches all teams in the account alongside users. **Avoid** — only use as a last resort. To get a specific user's teams, fetch that user by `userIds` instead.
Returns only teams, no users. Combine with `teamIds` for targeted team lookup, or with `includeTeamMembers` for full member details.
Set to `true` only when you need full member details for teams beyond names and IDs.

api.description: Creates a new board view (tab) with optional filters and sorting on a monday.com board using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The board ID to create the view on.
The type of board view to create. Defaults to TABLE. Use TABLE for standard board views.
The name of the view (e.g. "High Priority Items", "My Tasks").
Filter configuration. Contains rules (an array of { column_id, compare_value, operator }) and an optional operator (logical operator between rules, defaults to and).
Sort configuration. Array of { column_id, direction } objects. direction defaults to asc.
Type-specific view settings as a JSON object. The shape varies by view type. For TABLE views, prefer create_view_table.

api.description: Creates a new table-type board view with filters, sort, tags, and table-specific settings (column visibility/order and group-by) using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The board ID to create the table view on.
The name of the view (e.g. "High Priority Items", "My Tasks").
Filter configuration. Contains rules (an array of { column_id, compare_value, operator }) and an optional operator (logical operator between rules, defaults to and).
Sort configuration. Array of { column_id, direction } objects. direction defaults to asc.
Tags to apply to the view.
Table-specific settings: columns (visibility/order) and group_by, as described in monday's `create_view_table` MCP tool.

api.description: Updates an existing board view (tab) — its name, filters, or sort order — on a monday.com board using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the view to update.
The board ID the view belongs to.
The type of the board view being updated. Defaults to TABLE.
New name for the view (omit to leave unchanged).
Filter configuration. Contains rules (an array of { column_id, compare_value, operator }) and an optional operator (logical operator between rules, defaults to and).
Sort configuration. Array of { column_id, direction } objects. direction defaults to asc.
Type-specific view settings as a JSON object. The shape varies by view type. For TABLE views, prefer update_view_table.

api.description: Updates an existing table-type board view — name, filters, sort, tags, or table-specific settings (column visibility/order and group-by) using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the table view to update.
The board ID the view belongs to.
New name for the view (omit to leave unchanged).
Filter configuration. Contains rules (an array of { column_id, compare_value, operator }) and an optional operator (logical operator between rules, defaults to and).
Sort configuration. Array of { column_id, direction } objects. direction defaults to asc.
Tags to apply to the view.
Table-specific settings: columns (visibility/order) and group_by. Same shape as create_view_table.

api.description: Creates a new empty workflow in a monday.com workspace using the Platform MCP, returning the workflow object ID and draft ID.

fields.description: The ID of the workspace to create the workflow in.
Workflow title. Defaults to "New Workflow".
Visibility: PUBLIC (default) or PRIVATE.
Optional workflow description.
Optional folder ID to place the workflow in.
Optional list of user IDs to set as workflow owners.

api.description: Plans one or more monday.com workflows for a described process using an AI agent, returning a structured implementation plan, via the Platform MCP.

fields.description: Natural-language description of the full end-to-end process to plan (e.g. "When a deal is marked Won, create a task in the onboarding board and notify the account manager"). Maximum 2000 characters.

api.description: Asks the monday.com workflow expert about a workflow, or has it add, edit or delete steps from a natural-language prompt (on a draft, or on the live version when no draft ID is given), via the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The workflow object ID returned by create_workflow (also in the workflow URL). Not an automation id.
The draft to work on, from the latest create_workflow or workflows.update response. Omit to work on the live version.
A question about the workflow or the changes to make (e.g. "Add a trigger that fires when an item is created on the Marketing board").

api.description: Creates a new workspace in your monday.com account with a specified name, kind, and optional description using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The name of the new workspace.
The type of workspace to create. One of: `open`, `closed`, or `template`. Open workspaces are visible to all account members; closed workspaces require an explicit invite.
A short description of the workspace's purpose.
The account product ID to associate with the workspace (e.g., to scope the workspace to a specific monday product like CRM or Dev).

api.description: Returns the boards, docs, and folders inside a workspace, including which folder each item belongs to using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the workspace to retrieve information for. Use list_workspaces to find workspace IDs.

api.description: Returns a paginated list of all workspaces available to the authenticated user, including their IDs, names, and descriptions using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: Number of workspaces to return per page. Min: `1`, max: `100`, default: `100`. Use a lower value for smaller responses.
Page number to return. Default: `1`. Increment to paginate through large workspace lists.

api.description: Updates the name, description, kind, or account product association of an existing workspace using the Platform MCP.

fields.description: The ID of the workspace to update. Use list_workspaces to find workspace IDs.
The new name for the workspace.
The new description for the workspace.
The new kind for the workspace. One of: `open`, `closed`, or `template`.
The target account product ID to move the workspace to.
